messages:
mike_sales: EdgeGuard RFI just arrived. They ask for a consolidated capability matrix (feature + security + compliance), PoC plan for a 3-week eval, explicit KMS/HSM wording, and an EU-only data residency option. Deadline next Wed EOD. Link: https://edgeguard.example/rfi.pdf. @tara_se @josh_infra @anita_legal please advise.

tara_se: I'll own the capability matrix scoring. Propose scoring: supported/partial/unsupported + short notes. I'll call out model pinning, rollouts, function calling, and inference quality regressions.

josh_infra: For PoC ops, suggest 3 weeks: week1 infra + connectivity (peering/VPN), week2 perf & tuning, week3 acceptance + handover. Recommend starting with 3xA100-80GB equiv or 1xH100 if they want peak latency. Include autoscale disabled for determinism.

anita_legal: NDA required before sharing internal runbooks. For HSM wording: "Redwood supports customer-managed HSM integrations (PKCS#11, KMIP) on Private deployments; field engineering engagement and separate SOW required. Redwood will integrate but does not warrant third-party HSM hardware." Approved. Also flag: do not promise FedRAMP unless we list equivalent controls.

mike_sales: Pricing bullets to include: Hosted gen $0.0009/token, embeddings $0.00035/token; Dedicated = committed monthly + overage; Private = license + infra + support. Offer a one-time 10% PoC credit if they convert within 45 days. Also mention enterprise discounts for multi-year reserved Dedicated.

tara_se: Draft capability CSV snippet below 44 please edit scores/notes. I'll fill in perf rows after josh supplies numbers.

```csv
capability,score,notes
model_catalog,supported,"curated models + verified perf profiles"
streaming,supported,"server-side streaming + SDK support"
private_deploy,supported,"VPC, on-prem package, KMS & HSM integrations"
batching,partial,"automatic batching + manual controls; latency SLO knobs"
model_pinning,supported,"per-route model pinning + canary rollouts"
function_calling,partial,"structured outputs + basic tool calling; advanced runtime isolation in progress"
quant_profiles,partial,"A100 q8 validated; H100 q8 validation pending"
```

josh_infra: Perf/infra snippet for their ops team (YAML example they asked for):

```yaml
poc_environment:
  mode: dedicated
  nodes: 3
  gpu: a100-80gb
  autoscale: false
  runtime_image: redwood-runtime:2026-04
  networking:
    peering: true
    vpn: true
    allowed_cidrs: ["10.200.0.0/16"]
  data_residency: eu-only
```

mike_sales: @anita_legal ok to include the HSM sentence above and mention SOW + field eng? Also can we state SOC2 + ISO27001 in compliance bullets?

anita_legal: Yes include HSM sentence and SOW note. Confirm SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 certification status before listing them; mark PCI/GDPR as "controls aligned" but we cannot assert certification for PCI. For GDPR, state: "supports EU data residency and standard contractual clauses when needed."

ci-bot: Draft bundle created: https://redwood.internal/sales/edgeguard-draft (attachments: edgeguard_capability_matrix.csv, edgeguard_poc.yaml)

tara_se: I'll add an acceptance test plan: throughput >=1800 tokens/sec sustained (A100 option), 99p latency <350ms, error rate <0.5% over 30m. Also include regression evals for top-10 prompt set.

josh_infra: I'll own infra during PoC and provide monitoring + dashboards. Who will be primary for validation?

mike_sales: Tara will own validation and acceptance. Josh infra. Anita will sign off on legal wording and NDA. I'll assemble final bundle and send. Target send Wed EOD. Action items: tara perf numbers, josh final infra snippet, anita legal wording + NDA. Thanks all :thumbsup:
